title: Fx optimizer
description: The best optimization modpack of minecraft
body:
A performance-focused Fabric modpack for Minecraft with quality-of-life enhancements, visual upgrades, and zero compromises on FPS. Built for players who want smoother gameplay, faster loading times, and a better Minecraft experience without unnecessary bloat. This modpack is carefully optimized to maximize FPS, reduce memory usage, improve chunk loading, and eliminate common sources of lag. Every included mod has been selected to provide measurable performance benefits while maintaining compatibility and stability. Enjoy a collection of useful improvements that make Minecraft more convenient and enjoyable to play. Better interfaces, enhanced controls, inventory improvements, and helpful utilities allow you to focus on building, exploring, and surviving. Experience cleaner visuals and improved rendering while keeping performance as the top priority. The pack supports shaders and resource packs for players who want additional graphical enhancements without sacrificing stability. The modpack includes numerous fixes and optimizations designed to reduce crashes, improve memory management, and provide a smoother overall gameplay experience. Whether you're playing singleplayer or multiplayer, you can expect a stable environment. ## 🛠️ Create Your Own Modpack This modpack was created using **Mrptozip**, a simple tool that helps players build and manage their own Minecraft modpacks. 🌐 Website: [mrptozip.vercel.app](https://mrptozip.vercel.app) With Mrptozip, you can quickly organize mods, create custom packs, and share your creations with friends and the community. ---
⚡ Performance (11 mods) | Mod | Description | |-----|-------------| | [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) | Replaces the default rendering engine with a highly optimized one, giving massive FPS boosts especially on mid/low-end hardware. | | [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) | Optimizes game logic including mob AI, block ticking, and chunk loading without changing vanilla behavior. | | [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) | Runs chunk generation, loading, and saving on multiple threads simultaneously for much faster world loading. | | [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) | Reduces RAM usage significantly by optimizing how block states and model data are stored in memory. | | [EntityCulling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) | Skips rendering entities that are behind walls or otherwise not visible to the player. | | [MoreCulling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling) | Extends culling to leaves, vines, chests, and other block types that vanilla doesn't cull by default. | | [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) | Speeds up immediate mode rendering used by entities, GUIs, and HUD elements. | | [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) | A collection of small micro-optimizations that individually seem minor but add up noticeably. | | [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) | Drops FPS and pauses rendering when the game window is unfocused, saving CPU and GPU resources. | | [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton) | Optimizes the Minecraft networking stack to reduce bandwidth usage and improve server tick performance. | | [Clumps](https://modrinth.com/mod/clumps) | Groups XP orbs into a single entity to reduce lag in areas with large amounts of dropped XP. |
---
🎨 Visual (8 mods) | Mod | Description | |-----|-------------| | [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) | Adds full shader pack support compatible with OptiFine shaders while working alongside Sodium. | | [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) | Makes held light sources like torches and glowstone emit real dynamic light without shaders. | | [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) | Enables connected textures for blocks like glass and bookshelves using OptiFine-compatible resource packs. | | [OptiGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui) | Allows resource packs to replace GUI textures for containers like chests and furnaces. | | [NotEnoughAnimations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations) | Adds missing third-person animations for eating, drinking, map holding, and other actions. | | [SkinLayers3D](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) | Renders the outer layer of player skins as actual 3D geometry instead of a flat overlay. | | [BetterF3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3) | Replaces the cluttered default F3 debug screen with a clean, color-coded, and configurable version. | | [Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/capes) | Displays capes from OptiFine, LabyMod, and other platforms without needing those mods installed. |
---
🛠️ Quality of Life (11 mods) | Mod | Description | |-----|-------------| | [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) | Shows saturation and exhaustion values on the hunger bar and displays food stats on item tooltips. | | [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) | Adds a smooth, configurable zoom keybind with scroll-to-zoom support and cinematic camera option. | | [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) | Adds extra mouse drag behaviors in inventories like RMB dragging, scroll to move items, and more. | | [ShulkerBoxTooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) | Shows the contents of a shulker box in a tooltip when hovering over it in your inventory. | | [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads) | Displays the player's head avatar next to their messages in chat for easier identification. | | [Debugify](https://modrinth.com/mod/debugify) | Fixes a curated list of bugs from the Mojang bug tracker that haven't been officially patched yet. | | [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) | Strips the cryptographic signatures from chat messages to prevent them from being reported to Mojang. | | [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | Adds an in-game mod list screen where you can view all installed mods and access their config screens. | | [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) | Overhauls Sodium's video settings screen with a cleaner layout and better organization. | | [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) | Adds extra toggles to Sodium's settings like animations, particles, weather, and sky rendering. | | [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) | Adds proximity-based voice chat so players can talk to each other based on their in-game distance. |
---
📚 Libraries & Dependencies (6 mods) | Mod | Description | |-----|-------------| | [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | The core API library required by nearly all Fabric mods for hooks, events, and registry access. | | [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) | Adds Kotlin runtime support so mods written in Kotlin can run on Fabric. | | [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) | A shared config screen API used by many mods to display their settings in a consistent UI. | | [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) | Another config library with a more modern API used by newer mods like Zoomify and Iris. | | [Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) | Provides a system for text placeholders used by various mods for dynamic string substitution. | | [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) | Masa's shared utility library required by mods like MiniHUD and Litematica. |
--- ## 🚀 Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for MC **26.1.2** 2. Drop all `.jar` files into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder 3. Launch the game > Java 21+ required.
